WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.anlycount) as avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as avg_of_avgs
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.transreg,
    step1.tradekind,
    step1.avg_anlycount,
    step1.avg_anlycount - step2.avg_of_avgs as difference
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.avg_of_avgs IS NOT NULL
    AND step1.avg_anlycount > step2.avg_of_avgs
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_anlycount) as avg_anlycount,
    AVG(difference) as avg_difference
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as avg_of_avgs
  FROM step4
)
SELECT 
  step4.tradekind,
  step4.avg_anlycount,
  step4.avg_difference,
  step4.avg_anlycount / step5.avg_of_avgs as ratio
FROM step4
CROSS JOIN step5
WHERE step5.avg_of_avgs IS NOT NULL
